deals.evidence: The Penners’ investment equals about $672 million, and MLB has formally approved the deal.
deals.headline: Broncos owners' Penner Sports Group buys reported 40% of the Rockies
deals.seller: Existing partners (incl. The Denver Post, which sold its entire stake) and new equity
deals.summary: MLB-approved investment makes Penner Sports Group the Rockies' largest minority owner. The Denver Post reports a 40% stake from existing partners and new equity, about $672m (the Post's figure against Forbes' $1.68bn value); the club says it lets the franchise retire all outstanding debt.

ownership_summary: Controlled by brothers Dick and Charlie Monfort (owners since 1992; Dick is owner/chairman and CEO). In April 2026 Penner Sports Group, the Broncos-owning family entity of Greg and Carrie Penner, became the largest minority owner with a reported 40% stake (about $672m), funding retirement of all club debt; other limited partners include TSAM Sports, Fourseam Holdings, BDH Successor I and the Alvarado family partnership.
